key_insight: LLM-generated keywords can support virtual dataset discovery, but text-description quality affects which generation strategy performs best.
engineering_relevance: A multi-strategy keyword generation service can help users find existing virtual datasets and avoid duplicating data preparation work.
method: Define five strategies for selecting text to feed into LLM keyword generators.
Evaluate three LLM generators and two embedding techniques.
Adopt a multi-strategy keyword generation service within an extended data virtualization service.
evidence_signal: Experiments covered virtual datasets from five application case studies with different source datasets, showing that strategy performance depends on text-description quality.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative performance or scaling results, leaving deployment accuracy, latency, and cost uncertain.
paper_title: Automated Keyword Generation Using LLMs in a High-Volume Data Virtualization Service
